```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#' Build and save a sample-size companion bar chart next to an existing figure.
#' @param tab data.frame with columns: group (+ optional bins), N
#' @param save_dir Main_fig subfolder (e.g. "Figure1")
#' @param basename original figure's basename (no extension); saved as <basename>_sample_size.pdf/png
make_sample_size_fig <- function(tab, group_col, title, colors, save_dir, basename, bins_col = NULL, w = 7, h = 5) {
  total_n <- sum(tab$N)
  if (is.null(bins_col)) {
    p <- ggplot(tab, aes(x = .data[[group_col]], y = N, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
      geom_text(aes(label = N), vjust = -0.3, size = 5) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(tab, aes(x = .data[[bins_col]], y = N, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = N), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    w <- max(w, 8)
  }
  p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(title = paste0(title, " - Sample Sizes (Total N = ", total_n, ")"), y = "N")
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, save_dir, paste0(basename, "_sample_size.png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, save_dir, paste0(basename, "_sample_size.pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
#https://stackoverflow.com/questions/47651868/split-violin-plot-with-ggplot2-with-quantiles
GeomSplitViolin <- ggproto("GeomSplitViolin", GeomViolin,
  draw_group = function(self, data, ..., draw_quantiles = NULL) {
    # Original function by Jan Gleixner (@jan-glx)
    # Adjustments by Wouter van der Bijl (@Axeman)
    data <- transform(data, xminv = x - violinwidth * (x - xmin), xmaxv = x + violinwidth * (xmax - x))
    grp <- data[1, "group"]
    newdata <- plyr::arrange(transform(data, x = if (grp %% 2 == 1) xminv else xmaxv), if (grp %% 2 == 1) y else -y)
    newdata <- rbind(newdata[1, ], newdata, newdata[nrow(newdata), ], newdata[1, ])
    newdata[c(1, nrow(newdata) - 1, nrow(newdata)), "x"] <- round(newdata[1, "x"])
    if (length(draw_quantiles) > 0 & !scales::zero_range(range(data$y))) {
      stopifnot(all(draw_quantiles >= 0), all(draw_quantiles <= 1))
      quantiles <- create_quantile_segment_frame(data, draw_quantiles, split = TRUE, grp = grp)
      aesthetics <- data[rep(1, nrow(quantiles)), setdiff(names(data), c("x", "y")), drop = FALSE]
      aesthetics$alpha <- rep(1, nrow(quantiles))
      both <- cbind(quantiles, aesthetics)
      quantile_grob <- GeomPath$draw_panel(both, ...)
      ggplot2:::ggname("geom_split_violin", grid::grobTree(GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, ...), quantile_grob))
    }
    else {
      ggplot2:::ggname("geom_split_violin", GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, ...))
    }
  }
)

create_quantile_segment_frame <- function(data, draw_quantiles, split = FALSE, grp = NULL) {
  dens <- cumsum(data$density) / sum(data$density)
  ecdf <- stats::approxfun(dens, data$y)
  ys <- ecdf(draw_quantiles)
  violin.xminvs <- (stats::approxfun(data$y, data$xminv))(ys)
  violin.xmaxvs <- (stats::approxfun(data$y, data$xmaxv))(ys)
  violin.xs <- (stats::approxfun(data$y, data$x))(ys)
  if (grp %% 2 == 0) {
    data.frame(
      x = ggplot2:::interleave(violin.xs, violin.xmaxvs),
      y = rep(ys, each = 2), group = rep(ys, each = 2)
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(
      x = ggplot2:::interleave(violin.xminvs, violin.xs),
      y = rep(ys, each = 2), group = rep(ys, each = 2)
    )
  }
}

geom_split_violin <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "ydensity", position = "identity", ...,
                              draw_quantiles = NULL, trim = TRUE, scale = "area", na.rm = FALSE,
                              show.legend = NA, inherit.aes = TRUE) {
  layer(data = data, mapping = mapping, stat = stat, geom = GeomSplitViolin, position = position,
        show.legend = show.legend, inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
        params = list(trim = trim, scale = scale, draw_quantiles = draw_quantiles, na.rm = na.rm, ...))
}
```

```{r}



num_clone_fig <- function(immdata, type, title = "", num_cuts = 5, groupings = NA, colors = c("#E6BE60", "#A483AF"), method = "hochberg", legend_title = "", ylab = "", pval_label = "p.adj.signif", pval_size = 8, drop_d3 = FALSE){
  #' Visualize the number of clones over time
  #'
  #' @description This function calculates and visualizes the number of clones over time, grouping by specified categories and applying statistical tests to compare groups.
  #'
  #' @param immdata A dataframe containing immunosequencing data with `timepoint`, `PatientID`, and specified `type`.
  #' @param type A character string specifying the grouping variable for the analysis.
  #' @param title A character string for the plot title.
  #' @param num_cuts An integer indicating the number of bins to divide the timepoints into (default is 5).
  #' @param groupings Optional grouping variable for pairwise comparisons (default is NA).
  #' @param colors A character vector specifying colors for the plot (default is c("#E6BE60", "#A483AF")).
  #' @param method A character string specifying the p-value adjustment method (default is "hochberg").
  #' @param legend_title A character string for the legend title.
  #' @param ylab A character string for the y-axis label in the plot.
  #' @usage num_clone_fig(immdata, type, title, num_cuts, groupings, colors, method, legend_title, ylab)
  #' @return A list containing the plots, statistical test results, and processed data.

  immdata$timepoint <- as.character(immdata$timepoint) #Ensure timepoints are characters

  immdata <- immdata%>%
    mutate(timepoint = strtoi(timepoint)) #Convert back to integers
  immdata <- immdata[!is.na(immdata$timepoint),] #remove any NA timepoints
  immdata <- immdata[immdata$timepoint <= 365,]
  if (!drop_d3) {
    immdata_3 <- immdata[immdata$timepoint <= 3,]%>%
      mutate(timepoint = 3, bins = "3")%>%
      dplyr::filter(templates != 0)
  } else {
    immdata_3 <- immdata[0,] #drop_d3 = TRUE: exclude the D3 baseline bin entirely
  }
  immdata <- immdata[immdata$timepoint > 3,]
  immdata_all_timepoint <- immdata %>% #This is to keep track of timepoints that do not have any expanded clones
    select(all_of(c("timepoint","PatientID", type)))%>%
    distinct()

  immdata <- immdata[immdata$templates !=0, ]

  breaks <- unique(quantile(immdata_all_timepoint$timepoint, probs = 0:num_cuts/num_cuts, na.rm = T)) #Breaks based of all timepoints recorded
  print(breaks)

  immdata <- immdata%>%
    mutate(bins = cut(immdata$timepoint, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE))


  immdata_all_timepoint <- immdata_all_timepoint %>%
    mutate(bins = cut(immdata_all_timepoint$timepoint, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE))

  if(length(immdata_3$timepoint) != 0){
    immdata <- bind_rows(immdata_3, immdata)%>%
      mutate(bins = factor(bins, level = c("3", levels(immdata_all_timepoint$bins))))
  }else{
    immdata <- immdata%>%
      mutate(bins = factor(bins, level = levels(immdata_all_timepoint$bins)))
  }

  immdata_fig <- immdata%>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c("bins","timepoint","PatientID", type))))%>%
    tally()%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    dplyr::full_join(immdata_all_timepoint, by =c("PatientID", "bins","timepoint", type), multiple = "first")%>%
    replace_na(list(n = 0))%>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c("bins", type))))

  immdata_sum <- immdata_fig%>% ungroup()%>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c("bins", type))))%>%
    dplyr::summarise(m = mean(n), s = sqrt(var(n)))


  stat_test <- immdata_fig %>%
    group_by(bins) %>%
    mutate(n_in = n())%>%
    filter(n_in >= 3, sum(n != 0) > 0)%>% #dont do statistical test on groups that dont have enough samples
    pairwise_wilcox_test(as.formula(paste0(c("n ~ ",type))), p.adjust.method = "hochberg", exact = F, detailed = T)%>%
    add_xy_position(x = "bins")%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(
      y.position = log10(y.position+1),
      p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "hochberg"),
      p.adj.signif = symnum(p.adj,cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                            symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")),
      p.adj.exact = ifelse(p.adj < 0.001, sprintf("p = %.2e", p.adj), sprintf("p = %.3f", p.adj))
      )


  fig <- ggplot(immdata_sum, aes(x = bins, y = m, fill = .data[[type]], group = .data[[type]], color = .data[[type]])) +
    geom_line()+
    geom_point()+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = m - s, ymax = m + s, linetype = NA), alpha = 0.3)+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - s, ymax = m + s), width = 0.1)+
    scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, vjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"))+
    labs(title = title, y = ylab, x = "Days")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
    scale_color_manual(values=colors)

  fig_vio <- ggboxplot(immdata_fig, x = "bins", y = "n", fill = type, outlier.shape = NA)+
    geom_beeswarm(data = immdata_fig[immdata_fig$n != 0,], dodge.width = 0.75, cex = 0.1, corral.width = 0.2, method = "compactswarm", aes(x= bins, y = n, group = .data[[type]]))+
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test, label = pval_label, tip.length = 0.01, step.increase = 0.00, size = pval_size, bracket.nudge.y = -0.15)+
    scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)))+
    theme_pubr()+
    theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_markdown())+
    labs(title = title, y = ylab, x = "Days Post Transplant")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
    scale_color_manual(values=colors)

  return(list(fig, fig_vio, stat_test, immdata_fig, immdata_sum))
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 21, fig.height = 5}
# --- C_365_signif_hochberg: proper Hochberg via rstatix + stat_pvalue_manual ---
# Compute stats using base R wilcox.test + global Hochberg (same method as figures 1E and 1F)
# xmin/xmax set manually: No=1, Mild=2, Severe=3
lvls <- c("No", "Mild", "Severe")
pairs_list <- list(c("No","Mild"), c("No","Severe"), c("Mild","Severe"))

compute_hochberg <- function(data, var, y_max, step = 0.12) {
  ps <- sapply(pairs_list, function(p)
    wilcox.test(data[[var]][data$GVHD_GRADE_1 == p[1]],
                data[[var]][data$GVHD_GRADE_1 == p[2]], exact = FALSE)$p.value)
  padj <- p.adjust(ps, method = "hochberg")
  data.frame(
    group1       = c("No",   "No",     "Mild"),
    group2       = c("Mild", "Severe", "Severe"),
    xmin         = c(1, 1, 2),
    xmax         = c(2, 3, 3),
    y.position   = y_max * c(1 + step, 1 + 2*step, 1 + 3*step),
    p.adj        = padj,
    p.adj.signif = as.character(symnum(padj, cutpoints = c(0,0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.05,1),
                                       symbols = c("****","***","**","*","ns"))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stat_p1 <- compute_hochberg(patient_data_allo_365, "cum_freq",
                             y_max = max(patient_data_allo_365$cum_freq, na.rm = TRUE))

stat_p2_data <- patient_data_allo_365 %>% filter(!is.na(shannons.entropy))
stat_p2 <- compute_hochberg(stat_p2_data, "shannons.entropy",
                             y_max = max(stat_p2_data$shannons.entropy, na.rm = TRUE))

# Panel 3 y aesthetic is n+1 on log10 scale; y.position in n+1 space
# For Panel 3: aes is n+1 on log10 scale
# y.position must be in data (n+1) units; place brackets in log10 space just above max
n1_max   <- max(immdata_meta_365$n + 1, na.rm = TRUE)
log_max  <- log10(n1_max)
stat_p3  <- compute_hochberg(immdata_meta_365, "n", y_max = 1, step = 0) %>%
  mutate(y.position = 10^(log_max + c(0.15, 0.35, 0.55)))

cum_freq_plot_hochberg <- ggplot(patient_data_allo_365, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = cum_freq, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_p1 %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns"), label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5)+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.0001))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Alloreactive (<365 days)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Cumulative Frequency", fill = "GVHD Grade")

shannons_plot_hochberg <- ggplot(patient_data_allo_365 %>% filter(!is.na(shannons.entropy)), aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = shannons.entropy, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_p2 %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns"), label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Alloreactive (<365 days)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Shannon's Diversity Index", fill = "GVHD Grade")

  geom_boxplot()+

  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Mild", "Severe")),
    annotations = stat_p3$p.adj.signif[stat_p3$group1=="Mild" & stat_p3$group2=="Severe"],
    map_signif_level = FALSE,
    tip_length = 0.01,
    textsize = 5,
    y_position = log10(max(immdata_meta_365$n + 1, na.rm=TRUE)) + 0.25
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Alloreactive (<365 days)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "# of Clones", fill = "GVHD Grade")

# --- C_365_signif_hochberg_pval: same Hochberg correction, but display numeric p-values ---
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, sprintf("p = %.2e", p), sprintf("p = %.3f", p))

# Panel 1 (cum_freq) is on a log10 axis. stat_pvalue_manual mis-handles widely-spaced
# y.position values on log scales (it blew up the axis range to 0.001-1000). geom_signif
# instead takes raw plot-space (i.e. already-log10-transformed) coordinates directly,
```

```{r c-nonallo-365, fig.width=21, fig.height=5}
# --- C_nonallo_365: non-alloreactive equivalent of C_365 ---

# Build patient_data_nonallo_copy (mirrors patient_data_allo_copy processing)
patient_data_nonallo <- dplyr::full_join(patient_data_all_2, meta_data, by = "PatientID")
colnames(patient_data_nonallo) <- sapply(colnames(patient_data_nonallo), function(x){str_replace_all(x, "-", "")})
patient_data_nonallo <- patient_data_nonallo[patient_data_nonallo$Rep_div == "nonallo", ]
patient_data_nonallo <- patient_data_nonallo[which(!is.na(patient_data_nonallo$timepoint)), ]

patient_data_nonallo_copy <- patient_data_nonallo %>%
  mutate(timepoint = strtoi(timepoint)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint), !is.na(shannons.diversity)) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_grade_14 = ifelse(GVHD_grade_14 == "Yes", 1, 0),
         GVHD_grade_24 = ifelse(GVHD_grade_24 == "Yes", 1, 0),
         GVHD_grade_34 = ifelse(GVHD_grade_34 == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_GRADE = GVHD_grade_14 + GVHD_grade_24 + GVHD_grade_34) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_GRADE_1 = ifelse(grepl("Severe", GVHD_GRADE_1), "Severe", GVHD_GRADE_1)) %>%
  filter(timepoint > 3) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_GRADE_1 = factor(GVHD_GRADE_1, levels = c("No", "Mild", "Severe")))

if(remove_pat_regx != ""){
  patient_data_nonallo_copy <- patient_data_nonallo_copy[!grepl(remove_pat_regx, patient_data_nonallo_copy$PatientID), ]
}

# Build data_CD48_nonallo for clone count (num_clone_fig)
data_CD48_nonallo <- data_nonallo_squished %>%
  rename(PatientID = PatientID.x) %>%
  select(-PatientID.y) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(meta_data, by = "PatientID")

Both_results_nonallo <- num_clone_fig(data_CD48_nonallo, "PTCy", "PTCy vs No PTCy", num_cuts = 7, legend_title = "Treatment")
immdata_meta_nonallo <- dplyr::full_join(Both_results_nonallo[[4]], meta_data_clin, by = "PatientID") %>%
  mutate(PTCy = PTCy.x) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_GRADE_1 = ifelse(grepl("Severe", GVHD_GRADE_1), "Severe", as.character(GVHD_GRADE_1))) %>%
  mutate(GVHD_GRADE_1 = factor(GVHD_GRADE_1, levels = c("No", "Mild", "Severe"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint))

if(remove_pat_regx != ""){
  immdata_meta_nonallo <- immdata_meta_nonallo[!grepl(remove_pat_regx, immdata_meta_nonallo$PatientID), ]
}

immdata_meta_nonallo_365 <- immdata_meta_nonallo[
  !is.na(immdata_meta_nonallo$timepoint) &
  immdata_meta_nonallo$timepoint < 365 &
  immdata_meta_nonallo$timepoint > 3 &
  immdata_meta_nonallo$n > 0, ]

# --- C_nonallo_365_hochberg: proper Hochberg via rstatix-style wilcox.test + p.adjust (non-alloreactive) ---
# Reuses compute_hochberg(), pairs_list, lvls defined earlier in the C_365_signif_hochberg section
stat_p1_nonallo <- compute_hochberg(patient_data_nonallo_365, "cum_freq",
                             y_max = max(patient_data_nonallo_365$cum_freq, na.rm = TRUE))

stat_p2_data_nonallo <- patient_data_nonallo_365 %>% filter(!is.na(shannons.entropy))
stat_p2_nonallo <- compute_hochberg(stat_p2_data_nonallo, "shannons.entropy",
                             y_max = max(stat_p2_data_nonallo$shannons.entropy, na.rm = TRUE))

n1_max_nonallo  <- max(immdata_meta_nonallo_365$n + 1, na.rm = TRUE)
log_max_nonallo <- log10(n1_max_nonallo)
stat_p3_nonallo <- compute_hochberg(immdata_meta_nonallo_365, "n", y_max = 1, step = 0) %>%
  mutate(y.position = 10^(log_max_nonallo + c(0.15, 0.35, 0.55)))

cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- ggplot(patient_data_nonallo_365, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = cum_freq, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.0001))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Cumulative Frequency", fill = "GVHD Grade")
if(any(stat_p1_nonallo$p.adj.signif != "ns")){
  cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_p1_nonallo %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns"), label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5)
}

shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- ggplot(stat_p2_data_nonallo, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = shannons.entropy, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Shannon's Diversity Index", fill = "GVHD Grade")
if(any(stat_p2_nonallo$p.adj.signif != "ns")){
  shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_p2_nonallo %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns"), label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5)
}

clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- ggplot(immdata_meta_nonallo_365, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = n+1, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "# of Clones", fill = "GVHD Grade")
if(any(stat_p3_nonallo$p.adj.signif != "ns")){
  sig_p3_nonallo <- stat_p3_nonallo %>% filter(p.adj.signif != "ns")
  clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg <- clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg +
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      comparisons = lapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_p3_nonallo)), function(i) c(sig_p3_nonallo$group1[i], sig_p3_nonallo$group2[i])),
      annotations = sig_p3_nonallo$p.adj.signif,
      map_signif_level = FALSE,
      tip_length = 0.01,
      textsize = 5,
      y_position = sig_p3_nonallo$y.position
    )
}

C_nonallo_365_hochberg <- plot_grid(cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg, shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg, clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg, nrow = 1, align = "h", rel_widths = c(1,1,1.3))
plot(C_nonallo_365_hochberg)
ggsave(paste0(OUTPUT_PATH, '/Figure1/C_nonallo_365_hochberg.png'), C_nonallo_365_hochberg, width = 16.54, height = 3.94, dpi = 600)
ggsave(paste0(OUTPUT_PATH, '/Figure1/C_nonallo_365_hochberg.pdf'), C_nonallo_365_hochberg, width = 16.54, height = 3.94, dpi = 600)

make_sample_size_fig(tab_cnonallo365, "GVHD_GRADE_1", "C_nonallo_365_hochberg", grade3_colors, "Figure1", "C_nonallo_365_hochberg", w = 6)

# --- C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval: same Hochberg correction, but display numeric p-values ---
stat_p1_nonallo_pval <- stat_p1_nonallo %>% mutate(p.adj.label = fmt_p(p.adj))
stat_p2_nonallo_pval <- stat_p2_nonallo %>% mutate(p.adj.label = fmt_p(p.adj))
stat_p3_nonallo_pval <- stat_p3_nonallo %>% mutate(p.adj.label = fmt_p(p.adj))

cf_max_nonallo     <- max(patient_data_nonallo_365$cum_freq, na.rm = TRUE)
log_cf_max_nonallo <- log10(cf_max_nonallo)

cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval <- ggplot(patient_data_nonallo_365, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = cum_freq, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("No", "Mild"), c("No", "Severe"), c("Mild", "Severe")),
    annotations = stat_p1_nonallo_pval$p.adj.label,
    map_signif_level = FALSE,
    tip_length = 0.01,
    textsize = 4,
    y_position = log_cf_max_nonallo + c(0.15, 0.55, 0.95)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.0001))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Cumulative Frequency", fill = "GVHD Grade")

shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval <- ggplot(stat_p2_data_nonallo, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = shannons.entropy, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_p2_nonallo_pval, label = "p.adj.label", tip.length = 0.01, size = 4)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "Shannon's Diversity Index", fill = "GVHD Grade")

clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval <- ggplot(immdata_meta_nonallo_365, aes(x = GVHD_GRADE_1, y = n+1, group = GVHD_GRADE_1, fill = GVHD_GRADE_1))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("No", "Mild"), c("No", "Severe"), c("Mild", "Severe")),
    annotations = stat_p3_nonallo_pval$p.adj.label,
    map_signif_level = FALSE,
    tip_length = 0.01,
    textsize = 4,
    y_position = log_max_nonallo + c(0.15, 0.5, 0.85)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+
  scale_x_discrete(na.translate = F)+
  theme_pubr()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 18), legend.position = "right")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#09BB8C", "#005A8F", "#B85000", "grey"))+
  labs(title = "Non-alloreactive (<365)", x = "GVHD Grade", y = "# of Clones", fill = "GVHD Grade")

C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval <- plot_grid(cum_freq_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval, shannons_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval, clones_plot_nonallo_hochberg_pval, nrow = 1, align = "h", rel_widths = c(1,1,1.3))
plot(C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval)
ggsave(paste0(OUTPUT_PATH, '/Figure1/C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval.png'), C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval, width = 15.75, height = 3.75, dpi = 600)
ggsave(paste0(OUTPUT_PATH, '/Figure1/C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval.pdf'), C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval, width = 15.75, height = 3.75, dpi = 600)

make_sample_size_fig(tab_cnonallo365, "GVHD_GRADE_1", "C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval", grade3_colors, "Figure1", "C_nonallo_365_hochberg_pval", w = 6)
```
